title: Clock hour after a shift
description: A 24-hour clock shows hours 0 to 23. Return the hour shown after moving the clock by delta hours, forwards for a positive delta and backwards for a negative one, wrapping around midnight in both directions: 22 plus 5 gives 3, 2 minus 5 (delta -5) gives 21. hour is between 0 and 23, delta can be any integer. The result is always between 0 and 23.
notes: Experiment int_division: hidden tests use negative operands; the description states Euclidean-style non-negative remainder in words. The ref.zehn is written with int.div_floor / int.div_trunc / int.rem_euclid so it is valid under int_ops=operators and int_ops=explicit.
